The absence of remote-work indicators persists.

Still theoretically possible if work is entirely off-camera, but the consistent lack of 'work' object movement during core hours (11:55) makes this increasingly improbable compared to the 9-5 hypothesis.
Contradicted by consistent early morning activity (07:32) and clear weekday/weekend distinction. No evidence of night activity or late departures.
